title: A 'change my name' door on the server is open to anyone with a member key, but no app uses it
what: The server still offers a way for a member to rename themselves at their gym. No phone, admin app or worker calls it, and no test runs it; it is only named in the list of things allowed without signing in. It is unused code that stays open to the internet.
expected: Code nobody calls is removed, or, if members should be able to rename themselves, the app uses it and a test checks it.
who: nobody today; anyone with a member key could use it
fix_line: Remove the unused rename, or wire it into the app with a test

title: The oldest account link (make a gym from a sign-in, join by code, the phone's summary guard) is never run by any test
what: Making a gym from a signed-in owner account, joining a gym by code from a signed-in member account, and the guard that stops an old phone overwriting a newer workout summary are still used by the admin app and the phone. No database test calls them; they are only named in the list of what each role may call. A change that broke them would pass CI.
expected: Each of these still-used paths has a database test that runs it and checks the result, including a second gym seeing nothing.
who: owners and members on the old sign-in path
fix_line: Add one database test that runs these three paths

title: If the membership look fails, birthday and joined-day reminders quietly stop, with nothing logged
what: When the phone asks for its automatic reminder settings, the server also looks up the member's plan to find their birthday and join day. Any error in that look is swallowed: the reminders still arrive, but the birthday, join day and last visit come back empty, so those reminders never fire, and nothing records why.
expected: A failure in that look is written somewhere the team sees, or a test pins that the look cannot fail, so reminders cannot stop silently.
who: members of gyms that turned automatic reminders on
how_often: only if that look ever errors
fix_line: Log the swallowed error, or let it fail loudly in tests
